description: For two distinct subsets, independence is equivalent to infinitude of all four Boolean cells.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.IndependentFamilies.pair_iff.{u} {α : Type u} (A B : Set α) (hne : A ≠ B) :
  Lemmatheca.SetTheory.IndependentFamilies.IsIndependent {A, B} ↔
    (A ∩ B).Infinite ∧ (A \ B).Infinite ∧ (B \ A).Infinite ∧ (A ∪ B)ᶜ.Infinite
